verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal docs explicitly support chip/contactless card reads and Tap to Pay for mobile-wallet/contactless acceptance on compatible phones, plus SDKs and no-code reader options for in-person payment acceptance, corroborated by independent hands-on community reports of building a POS atop Terminal. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation/citation confirming Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet acceptance specifically via physical smart readers (only iPhone Tap to Pay and generic contactless is cited) and no independent review confirming chip-card EMV certification details.
